body: In fact, there are several places in the code where we call `MinimizationOperations.minimize()` with `Integer.MAX_VALUE` as the work limit, where we should really be passing `Operations.DEFAULT_DETERMINIZE_WORK_LIMIT` instead.

Slightly related: Regex queries [max_determinized_states](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/query-dsl-regexp-query.html) also allows upping this to way beyond 10000 (default) intentionally. This shouldn't be an accident but maybe we also need to add an internal cluster setting limit here to prevent misuse.

Also slightly related: security has a setting that caps automata "max_determinized_states" at 100.000 by default and seems to use the Operations.DEFAULT_DETERMINIZE_WORK_LIMIT as a minimal value: https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/query-dsl-regexp-query.html.
There seems to be several cases in out code where we minimize "just in case" but is is a no-op because the input automaton is already determiniztic.

issue.title: Limit _terms_enum prefix size

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently the prefix size of the `_terms_enum` endpoint are not limited in size.
Since they run against a keyword field and build automata, this can lead to high memory
consumption and the danger of running OOM.  This change check the size of the prefix
early in the rest request and throw a validation error in case it exceeds 
IndexWriter.MAX_TERM_LENGTH, which is the same limit we apply to the length of 
keyword field values anyway, so this comes at no loss in functionality.

Closes #96572

issue.title: Limit several determinization limits for automata

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Determinization of automata can be an expensive operation, which is why Lucenes MinimizationOperations allows to limit the amount of work allowed in this step. The default limit should be Operations.DEFAULT_DETERMINIZE_WORK_LIMIT, but we use Integer.MAX in several places. Instead, we can limit this to even 0 in many places where by the construction of the automaton it is clear that it is already determinized.
This changes this limit to 0 where possible and adds tests and assertions to make sure the constructed automata are deterministic already, also simplifying some internal API along the way.

Relates to #96572
